script.spoken: All 155 people aboard survived. Both engines died at under three thousand feet over New York. Just 208 seconds later, the jet was floating in the Hudson River. The cause was a flock of Canada geese. The engines were tested against birds of about four pounds. Canada geese weigh about eight. Two engines, both beyond their design limit, at the same moment. The pilots' calm turned an engineering failure into a survival story.
